rca_of_issue:
FastAPI matches routes in declaration (registration) order. In /app/backend/routes/chat.py the order is:
  line 503  @router.get('/chat/{thread_id}/messages')   ← dynamic, matches '/chat/<anything>/messages'
  line 524  @router.get('/chat/search/messages')        ← static, unreachable
  line 546  @router.post('/chat/{thread_id}/messages')  ← POST, irrelevant for GET resolution
When the test issues GET /api/chat/search/messages?q=..., the URL is matched by the line-503 pattern with thread_id='search'. The handler then calls _assert_thread_member('search', user_id) which raises HTTPException(404, 'Chat not found'). The earlier fix relocated the search route only past the POST handler, which has no bearing on GET resolution — the GET dynamic handler still shadows it. Fix: swap the order so the static path is registered first.
